title: Network checkout opens: the three Network items join the catalog, a Space can buy Network from its billing page, and the pricing and Networks pages say Start a Network

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-16: chose "Create all six" on "Create the Network prices in Stripe and open Network checkout?", then "go".

detail: The six Network prices exist on the live Stripe account (network_base, nonprofit_network and network_chapter, monthly and yearly). network_base, network_chapter and nonprofit_network join CATALOG_ITEM_KEYS at the NETWORK_PLAN amounts, so the catalog sync finds the products by metadata. The loadout checkout sells plan network as the network_base item on the Collective sell switch, the webhook reconciles a network item to spaces.plan = network, and the billing ladder offers a free Space a one-click Choose Network. NETWORK_PLAN.stripePriceId is the base monthly price, so networkCheckoutOpen() is true and the pricing and Networks pages say Start a Network. Migration 20270346009100 widens space_subscription_items.item_key and maps the twelve price keys. Extra chapters past ten and the non profit Network checkout are not offered yet.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const k=fs.readFileSync('lib/billing/pricing-keys.ts','utf8');const p=fs.readFileSync('lib/pricing/plans.ts','utf8');const c=fs.readFileSync('lib/billing/space-plan-checkout.ts','utf8');const i=fs.readFileSync('lib/billing/space-subscription-items.ts','utf8');const bad=[];for(const x of ['network_base','network_chapter','nonprofit_network'])if(!new RegExp(\"^  '\"+x+\"',$\",'m').test(k))bad.push(x+' not in the catalog');if(/stripePriceId: null/.test(p))bad.push('Network still quote only');if(!/loadout.plan === 'network'\) return \[\{ key: 'network_base'/.test(c))bad.push('checkout cannot sell Network');if(!/itemKeys.includes\('network'\)\) return 'network'/.test(i))bad.push('a Network subscription does not reconcile to the network plan');if(!fs.existsSync('supabase/migrations/20270346009100_network_checkout.sql'))bad.push('migration missing');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-980: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
